HTTPBearer.description: JWT de acces emis de serviciul de autorizare (aud=pfa-api), valabil 5 minute. Se trimite ca `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

info.description:
Multi-tenant Romanian PFA accounting, tax calculation and ANAF reporting.

Business endpoints require a bearer access token; application authentication is cookie-free. Use **Authorize** to either paste a short-lived access token or run the real authorization-code + PKCE login, then call any endpoint from here.

Values that are not available are visible rather than silent: an obligation reports which of detect/calculate/generate/submit is supported and why, and an unverified deadline reads `Termen de verificat` instead of an invented date.
info.title: PFA Accounting API

post.description:
Send a fresh activation link when the previous one expired or was lost.

The answer is always the same whether or not an unverified account exists, so
the endpoint cannot be used to enumerate accounts.  It is rate limited both per
account (protecting the mailbox owner from flooding) and per source address.

schema.title: Response Resend Email Verification Auth Verify Email Resend Post

get.description:
Backend-only external OAuth callback.

Returns the browser to the SPA without any token; the SPA receives only
connection status.

Validate the request and render the login page, or fail locally.

An invalid client/redirect shows a local error page and never redirects to the
supplied URI.

``transaction`` re-renders an existing, still-valid authorization transaction:
that is how a failed login returns here (with a fresh one-use proof) instead of
leaving a stale POST URL in the browser, so a reload is safe.
